title: [7.3] [Social] Governor Nexus Update
headline: ENS is voting on approving Governor Nexus, a new version of its governor contract, which would go through an external audit funded by MetaGov before any migration proposal.
summary: This social vote asks the ENS DAO to approve the Governor Nexus update, built on OpenZeppelin v5.6.1 to address risks found in a Governance Security Assessment that placed ENS at Stage 0 under the Anticapture framework. Changes described: a per-proposal-type voting delay (2 days in the migration proposal); a limit of 2 live proposals per proposer, adjustable between 1 and 10; mutable votes that can be recast before the deadline; a 48-hour extension if a proposal flips from failing to passing in the final 24 hours; a governed proposal-type registry starting with Standard, Optimistic (passes unless 500k ENS oppose) and Bond (1,000 ENS); and batch voting plus ERC-1271 signatures for contract wallets. The Timelock is untouched. The audit scope is the code written on top of OpenZeppelin's library; quotes from three firms range from $14,000 to $25,000; MetaGov stewards pick the firm and pay from its Term 7 contract-audits line, with no new DAO funding. If the vote passes, a migration proposal follows after the audit.
vote: For 100% (1,015 ENS) / Against 0 / Abstain 0 so far, ends 2026-11-03
